## NOC-288: Integration Branch Ready for PR to Main

### Branch: `integration/noc-288-full` (head `360bd21`)

### All Local Gates Verified ✅

| Step | Command | Result |
|------|---------|--------|
| Backend deps | `npm ci` | ✅ 168 packages |
| Backend typecheck | `npx tsc --noEmit` | ✅ clean |
| Backend tests | `npm test` | ✅ **734 passing** (includes NOC-263 auth-key-fallback regression tests) |
| Backend build | `npm run build` | ✅ clean `tsc` compile |
| Frontend deps | `npm ci` (frontend) | ✅ 489 packages |
| Frontend lint | `npm run lint` | ✅ (warnings only, no errors) |
| Frontend build | `npm run build` | ✅ Next.js production build complete |
| Encoding check | `./scripts/check-encoding.sh` | ✅ UTF-8, no NUL bytes, no UTF-16 BOM |

### Integration Contents
- **Backend P0 candidate:** `47bbcd7` (merge of NOC-284 teams fix + NOC-285 auth cleanup + NOC-292 cleanup)
- **Auth regression tests:** `6cca076` (7 cases for NOC-263 unloadable `CLERK_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY` JWKS fallback)
- **Frontend Add App wizard:** `f8042f4` + `360bd21` (NOC-252 real API calls with persisted test check)
- **NOC-291 frontend contract fix:** `abc60af` (wizard calls `POST /api/apps` and `POST /api/apps/:id/test-check`)
- **Onboarding router:** `1f05f37` (added to tRPC app router)

All contracts match: wizard `create`/`testCheck` calls invoke protected backend app routes with session token. No local-only app list, no simulated results. Persisted check runs after app creation.

### CI Workflow
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` includes `encoding-check` job running before backend/frontend
- `.github/workflows/verify-controlled-identities.yml` includes `guard-checks` job (ownership claim + identifier redaction)
- Both workflows trigger on PR to `main`

### Next Steps
1. **Create PR** `integration/noc-288-full` → `main` to trigger CI + review gates
2. After CI/review pass, Render deployment workflow serves merged SHA
3. Record production probes per NOC-288 acceptance criteria

**Action Required:** Create PR to `main` (no `gh` CLI in environment; use GitHub UI or authorized token).
head: 360bd21
